classification_rationale: The customer wants to hold the same unit they used previously for an upcoming visit, which is a booking/reservation request the account record can identify and act on.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thanks for getting in touch, and glad the unit worked well for you last time.

We check availability live against the booking system, so until you have firm dates for your next visit we can't hold that specific unit in advance — availability given this far ahead is only ever indicative until a booking is actually confirmed. Once you have dates, let us know and we'll do our best to put you on the same unit if it's free; if it's already out, we'll offer you the nearest equivalent.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
